newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere cool about possible end of Thomson sale.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere cool about possible end of Thomson sale.

text.p: Jean-Luc Lagardere, chairman of books to missiles group Lagadere, said on Friday that an end to the privatisation of Thomson-CSF would be "rather serious" but "not dramatic".

The Socialist Party, if voted to power in Sunday's second round of the parliamentary election, would stop the current government's plans to sell the state's 58 percent stake in the defence electronics group.
Lagardere Groupe, with help from British Aerospace, has made a firm offer for the Thomson-CSF stake in competition with a joint offer by Alcatel Alsthom and private Dassault Industrie.
The outgoing government said it would decide on the matter before the end of June, but after the election.
"If the left wins that would mean the end of the privatisation of Thomson-CSF ... I consider that rather serious," Lagardere said, adding it would not be "dramatic" for his group.
